notes: Subject insert through multiple_of (transitive). 'Even' is being a multiple of 2 (the chain says so; firm). q3 (is the Pellow number prime?) needs no arithmetic: it is a multiple of 2 through the transitive multiple_of, a prime that is a multiple of 2 is 2 itself (firm rule, from 'no divisors other than 1 and itself'), and the Pellow number is not 2, since multiple_of is asymmetric (2 is not a multiple of 12). Relabelled dl (theory arithmetic dropped) on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check.

fol.notes: Multiples and remainders are built-in arithmetic (12 is a multiple of 6 and of 2 needs no stored fact, so it never shows in a core). Primality is the model's predicate, constrained only by the stored definition, instantiated at the Pellow number and the divisor 2 the chain uses.

prime_def.says: A prime number has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.
prime_def.z3: All([n, d], [(pellow, 2)], Implies(And(prime(n), n % d == 0), Or(d == 1, d == n)))
